title: Sum Two Numbers
description: Calculate the sum of two numbers
instructions: Write a function that takes two numbers and returns their sum
solution:

title: Even or Odd
description: Determine if a number is even or odd
instructions: Write a function that returns 'even' if the number is even, 'odd' otherwise
solution:
def even_or_odd(n):
    return 'even' if n % 2 == 0 else 'odd'

title: Find Maximum
description: Find the largest number in a list
instructions: Write a function that finds and returns the maximum value in a list of numbers
solution:
def find_max(numbers):
    return max(numbers)

title: Reverse a String
description: Reverse the characters in a string
instructions: Write a function that takes a string and returns it reversed
solution:
def reverse_string(s):
    return s[::-1]

title: Merge Dictionaries
description: Merge two dictionaries
instructions: Write a function that merges two dictionaries, with values from the second dictionary overwriting the first
solution:
def merge_dicts(dict1, dict2):
    result = dict1.copy()
    result.update(dict2)
    return result

title: Celsius to Fahrenheit
description: Convert temperature from Celsius to Fahrenheit
instructions: Write a function that converts a temperature from Celsius to Fahrenheit using the formula F = C × 9/5 + 32
solution:
def celsius_to_fahrenheit(celsius):
    return celsius * 9/5 + 32

title: List Intersection
description: Find common elements in two lists
instructions: Write a function that returns a list of elements that appear in both input lists
solution:
def list_intersection(list1, list2):
    return list(set(list1) & set(list2))
